s_29671.text_1: Use a Ghast Helm to control the Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
s_29671.text_6: Alt automatically approaches a nearby unpowered assembly station.
s_29671.title: Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station Controls
scene_1.text_1: Use a Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station to assemble your Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
scene_1.text_2: Use Super Glue to glue your balloon together.
scene_1.text_3: Buffer Pads can prevent the structure from getting stuck in the ground.
scene_1.text_4: Then power the assembly station with redstone...
scene_1.text_5: Then place a Ghast above the assembly station...
scene_1.text_7: Approach an unpowered assembly station or use Shears on the rope to disassemble the structure.
